name: com.nova.animation
description: Unity's Animator: state machines with parameters and transitions (Animator Controller assets and the Animator window), Blend Trees (1D / 2D), root motion, and Humanoid retargeting so clips made for one skeleton play on another. Procedural animation components: Legs Animator (feet stay on uneven ground, hips follow) and Look Animator (head, neck and spine turn toward a target). C#: Animator.SetFloat / Play / CrossFade / applyRootMotion, LegsAnimator, LookAnimator. Included in new projects by default.
